decisions.rationale: One row per weather station per hour: origin has 3 distinct values and time_hour has 4341 distinct values, whose product (13023) closely matches row_count 13014, consistent with a few missing station-hours; both columns have null_rate 0.0.
duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 13014, so no deduplication step is applied.
_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, and _airbyte_meta carry is_airbyte_metadata true and describe the sync, not the weather observations; all three are dropped.
time_hour landed as VARCHAR but every sample is ISO-8601 UTC (e.g. 2013-01-01T06:00:00Z); cast to TIMESTAMP so the grain key is time-typed.
year, month, day, hour, and wind_dir landed as DECIMAL(38,9) but all profiled values are integral (e.g. month distinct_values 1.0-6.0, hour min 0.0 max 23.0); cast to INTEGER.
wind_gust is null in 74.55% of rows (9702 of 13014); nulls plausibly mean no gust recorded, so the column is retained nullable with no imputation.
pressure has null_rate 0.114953 (1496 nulls); nulls are retained rather than imputed or used to drop rows.
wind_speed max is 1048.36058 against typical samples of 0-13, an evident unit or sensor anomaly; the value is retained unchanged and flagged here for reviewer attention rather than silently filtered.

purpose: Hourly weather observations for the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) during January through June 2013, cleaned from the bronze Airbyte landing into typed columns at a one-row-per-station-per-hour grain. It feeds downstream joins to flight and delay analyses and any consumer needing airport-level weather context.
usage: Join on origin plus time_hour (TIMESTAMP, UTC) as the declared grain. Numeric measures are typed DOUBLE or INTEGER; wind_gust (74.5% null), pressure (11.5% null), wind_dir (1.7% null), and wind_speed (two nulls) retain their nulls, so consumers must handle nulls explicitly rather than assume complete coverage. Note wind_speed contains at least one extreme value (max 1048.4) that consumers should filter or winsorize deliberately.
limitations: No imputation was performed: wind_gust remains null in 74.55% of rows and pressure in 11.5% of rows. The wind_speed outlier (max 1048.36 versus a sampled range near 0-13) was retained unmodified because the cleanup does not alter measured values. Coverage spans only year 2013, months 1-6, and about 9 station-hours are missing relative to a full 3x4341 grid (13014 rows versus 13023 possible). Airbyte metadata columns were dropped, so sync lineage is not carried into silver.
